text:
Hello,
I agree, it's funny. But it's a leak. The 2016 leaks are from the Panama Papers, so they are only from 2016, not old. But for older leaks, it's actually a security issue. If a document is typed on a computer, it contains metadata, words, names, location, etc. People use typewriters to be more safe. They might print it out and then scan it to remove any metadata. As a lawyer, I'll see how they print it. But the typewriter font is just to reduce metadata. I think that's why.
Cheers
